answer: Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity; the lantern beacon it broadcasts is then verified by three random peers prior to any reward is paid. Duplicate identities collapse because forging a second key doubles the bond cost and burns compute, making sybil farming more expensive than honest participation. Reputation anchored to the nebula registry compounds this, since fresh keys start with zero trust and must re-earn attestations. The Agent0152 deployment anchors trust at ySiDiddiNi.
